input.assignment_instructions: Initial reconnaissance on both in-scope targets, starting with DVWA at security level low. (1) DVWA (http://dvwa, session dvwa_admin): confirm the authenticated session, record the current security level (should be low), and map the SQL Injection page /vulnerabilities/sqli/ (GET param id), the Command Injection page /vulnerabilities/exec/ (POST param ip), and the Stored XSS page /vulnerabilities/xss_s/ (message and name fields, including the submit field and maxlength). Also note /vulnerabilities/sqli/session-input.php. Record each suspected endpoint as pending_verification with its CWE. Do not change the security level yet. (2) Juice Shop (http://juiceshop:3000): using the unauth session, fetch the SPA entry and REST surfaces needed to identify /rest/user/login, /rest/products/search?q=, /api/Feedbacks, /ftp/ (request with Accept: text/html,application/json), /encryptionkeys/, and /rest/basket/<id>. Using juiceshop_acct1, record its own_basket_id from session_info. Keep HTTP usage modest; avoid browser_navigate unless essential. Report endpoints with parameters and session context.
